question:
Identify the incorrectly spelt word and select its correct spelling.

It is his previlage to present all the candidates for ordination to the bishop of the diocese.
solution: The correct answer is **Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"prevalage"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"privilege". **(विशेषाधिकार) • **Example:** It is a **privilege** to be invited to such an exclusive event. • **"Privilege"** refers to a special right, advantage, or immunity granted to a particular person or group. (विशेषाधिकार) • **Example:** Being able to attend the conference was a **privilege** for the young scientists. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Odination** (ऑर्डिनेशन): This word is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is** "ordination". **(संन्यास) • **Example:** The ceremony of ordination was held at the cathedral. • **Deocease** (डायोसिस): This word is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is** "diocese". **(धर्मप्रांत) • **Example:** The bishop oversees the** diocese** with great care. 3f:Tb9f, The correct answer is **Option 3)**
